```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
#load library
library(b3gbi)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
{{< include TotalOccurrences.Rmd >}}

```{r, eval=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
#load library
library(b3gbi)

TO_map <- total_occ_map(Angiosperm_data_cube,
                            cell_size="grid")

TO_ts <- total_occ_ts(Angiosperm_data_cube, 
                          cell_size="grid")

plot_map(TO_map, 
         visible_gridlines = FALSE)

plot_ts(TO_ts)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
angioGBIF <- read.csv('Angiosperm_data_Flanders_1km.csv')

angio_p <- b3gbi::process_cube(angioGBIF)

df_plot <- angio_p$data %>%
  group_by(xcoord, ycoord, cellCode) %>%
  summarize(sum_obs = sum(obs))


TO_map_plot <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = xcoord, y = ycoord, colour = sum_obs)) + geom_point() +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "D",
                         values = c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1),
                         name = "number of occurrences")+
  theme_void()


ggsave(
  filename = "./Flanders_1km/Total_occurrences_map.png",
  plot = TO_map_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

```

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
TO_ts <- readRDS('./Flanders_1km/TO_ts.rds')

TO_ts_data <- TO_ts$data

TO_ts_graph <- ggplot(TO_ts_data, aes(year, diversity_val)) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    colour = "#48A529"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    se = FALSE,
    colour = "#005957",
    fill = "#6CDDB4",
    linewidth = 1.3
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(min(TO_ts_data$year, na.rm = TRUE), 2022)
  ) +
labs(
    title = "Total number of occurrences in Flanders",
    y = "Number of occurrences",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  filename = "./Flanders_1km/Total_occurrences_timeseries.png",
  plot = TO_ts_graph,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
{{< include ObservedSpeciesRichness.Rmd >}}

```{r, eval=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
#load library
library(b3gbi)


#Execute preprocessing step (TEST)
OSR_map <- obs_richness_map(Angiosperm_data_cube,
                            cell_size="grid")

OSR_ts <- obs_richness_ts(Angiosperm_data_cube, 
                          cell_size="grid")

plot_map(OSR_map,
         visible_gridlines = FALSE)

plot_ts(OSR_ts)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
OSR_map <- readRDS("./Flanders_1km/OSR_map.rds")$data

OSR_map_plot <- ggplot(data = OSR_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = diversity_val), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = NA, name='number of species') +
  theme_void()

ggsave(
  filename = "./Flanders_1km/Observed_species_richness_map.png",
  plot = OSR_map_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

The map below displays observed species richness in Flanders, but only where completeness is larger than 0.5. The regions which are not displayed, are undersampled.

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
completeness_map <- readRDS("./Flanders_1km/ComP_map.rds")$data


threshold <- 0.5

# Assuming both datasets have the same geometry/order
OSR_masked <- OSR_map %>%
  left_join(
    completeness_map %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(cellCode, completeness=diversity_val),
    by = "cellCode"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diversity_val = ifelse(completeness >= threshold,
                           diversity_val,
                           NA)
  )

OSR_mask_plot <- ggplot(data = OSR_masked) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = diversity_val), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = NA,
                       name= 'Number of species') +
  theme_void()+
  theme(legend.title = element_text("Number of occurrences"))

ggsave(
  filename = "./Flanders_1km/Observed_species_richness_masked_map.png",
  plot = OSR_mask_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
OSR_ts <- readRDS('./Flanders_1km/OSR_ts.rds')

data <- OSR_ts$data
OSR_ts_plot <- ggplot(data, aes(year, diversity_val)) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    colour = "#48A529"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    se = FALSE,
    colour = "#005957",
    fill = "#6CDDB4",
    linewidth = 1.3
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(min(data$year, na.rm = TRUE), 2022)
  ) +
labs(
    title = "Total observed species richness of flowering plants in Flanders",
    y = "Number of species",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  filename = "./Flanders_1km/Observed_species_richness_timeseries.png",
  plot = OSR_ts_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

In the graph below, observed species richness is corrected for total occurrences.

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
#OSR corrected for TO
OSR_ts$data$TO<- TO_ts_data$diversity_val
OSR_ts$data$diversity_val <- OSR_ts$data$diversity_val/OSR_ts$data$TO
plot_ts(OSR_ts,
        y_label ='Total observed species / Total occurrences',
        max_year=2022)


```

```{r, eval=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}

```


```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}

    colour = "#005957",
```
